page.overview:
Who is Fluffykins?

Aang, trying to help a poverty-stricken Ba Sing Se zookeeper, decided to construct new enclosures for the city zoo in the Agrarian Zone. Aang gathered the mass of animals and herded them in a chaotic stampede through the city toward the Inner Wall. Fluffykins, lured by the sound of Aang's bison whistle, joined the animals sometime during the rush and was accidentally corralled into the same exhibit as the elephant mandrill.

Once inside the zoo, the cat was found by her owner, who expressed confusion as to why her pet was there, saying "Fluffykins? What are you doing down there?"
